subject: Original Porous Lantern L3-30
method: Web search, followed by examination of promising papers, author texts, or publisher records. Source publication dates were taken from the papers or publication records, not search-engine crawl dates. No exhaustive catalogue search or proof of historical priority was attempted.
query_batches: fractal self similar spatial zippers octagon rotation
"On Selfsimilar Jordan Curves on the Plane" DOI

primary_sources.author: Kevin G. Hare
primary_sources.title: More Variations on the Sierpiński Sieve
primary_sources.examined: Full text, especially Section 2, equation (2.1), Figures 3 and 7, and the order-one eight-gasket discussion.
primary_sources.relevance: Closest explicit construction found: planar eight-gasket with the same ratio and multiple overlaps.
primary_sources.comparison_status: Our analytical deduction identifies the zero-roll control with this attractor up to similarity. The fixed 30-degree Lantern is nonplanar, so this is not an exact match to the released object.

primary_sources.title: Fractal n-gons and their Mandelbrot sets
primary_sources.examined: Paper abstract, introduction, definition, and Proposition 1; publication metadata checked against the author's university list.
primary_sources.relevance: Cyclic symmetry acting transitively on planar self-similar pieces.
primary_sources.comparison_status: General methodological precedent; planar scope does not identify the nonplanar Lantern.
primary_sources.access_note: The DOI URL did not resolve through the web tool; the paper text and author publication listing were available.

primary_sources.author: John E. Hutchinson
primary_sources.title: Fractals and Self Similarity
primary_sources.examined: Author-hosted retyped paper, introduction and section structure for invariant sets and parametrised curves.
primary_sources.comparison_status: Foundation, not an exact shape precedent.

primary_sources.title: On Selfsimilar Jordan Curves on the Plane
primary_sources.examined: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record, and indexed opening of author/institution-hosted full text describing endpoint coupling and general zipper definitions.
primary_sources.comparison_status: Methodological precedent; does not establish a Jordan property for the Lantern's paths.

primary_sources.author: Fan Wen
primary_sources.title: Fractal necklaces with no cut points
primary_sources.examined: Author preprint v4 dated 19 February 2022, especially Definition 1 and introductory topology discussion.
primary_sources.relevance: Precisely states single-point intersections required for this formal necklace class.
primary_sources.comparison_status: The Lantern's displayed eight-map system violates the adjacent-singleton hypothesis. No theorem transfer asserted.
primary_sources.access_note: Journal DOI URL did not resolve through the web tool; the author's full preprint was available.

primary_sources.author: Donald Plante
primary_sources.title: 3D Printable Golden Sponges
primary_sources.relevance: Physical finite approximations of overlapping spatial IFS attractors.
primary_sources.comparison_status: Broader sculpture context; no exact Lantern match.

additional_leads_screened.title: Golden Gaskets: Variations on the Sierpiński Sieve
additional_leads_screened.disposition: Primary text examined; overlaps and holes in planar triangular IFSs. Hare's octagonal extension is the closer source used in the public comparison.

additional_leads_screened.title: Topological Rigidity of good fractal necklaces
additional_leads_screened.author: Fan Wen
additional_leads_screened.disposition: Author abstract examined; concerns good necklaces. Not used to infer rigidity for the Lantern.

additional_leads_screened.title: Octagonal Tiling (1225), IFS Encyclopedia
additional_leads_screened.disposition: Indexed explicit AIFS screened: planar, graph-directed, two attractor types. Shares silver-ratio geometry but not the spatial eight-map recipe. Not used as historical priority evidence.

additional_leads_screened.title: Ammann–Beenker Tiling, IFS Encyclopedia
additional_leads_screened.disposition: Indexed description screened; planar substitution tiling, not the Lantern. Not treated as an exact prior-art match.

additional_leads_screened.title: Antoine's Necklace
additional_leads_screened.disposition: Search lead only. A Cantor-set necklace is a different topology from the connected Lantern; not used to establish historical details in the public account.

additional_leads_screened.title: Styrofoam IFS Gallery
additional_leads_screened.disposition: Indexed artist examples screened, including rotated hexagonal arrangements. No inspected formula identifies the fixed Lantern; no priority conclusion drawn from visual descriptions.

analytical_comparison.label: Deduction made in this study, checked independently by the mathematical-audit agent
analytical_comparison.parameter_change_for_comparison_only: Set beta=0; the released beta=30 recipe remains fixed.
analytical_comparison.conclusion: The zero-roll control is similarity-equivalent to Hare's order-one eight-gasket. The nonzero-roll attractor is spatial and cannot be similarity-equivalent to a planar set.

finding: No inspected source identified the complete fixed L3-30 spatial recipe. Established mechanisms and a known planar control were identified.
limitations: This was a targeted web and literature search, not an exhaustive review.
Unindexed artwork, unavailable material, and unpublished experiments were not excluded.
Different coordinate normalisations, map permutations, or internal symmetries may disguise identical attractors.
No general algorithm deciding similarity of all candidate attractors was run.
A similar picture or a shared contraction ratio does not by itself establish an identical recipe or set.
No contact with the cited authors was undertaken.
